Other Inspections and Fees: 
1. Inspections outside of normal business hours (2 Hour Minimum Charge) $54.00/ hour 
2. Re-inspection fees assessed under provisions of Sections 108.8 IRC & 109.7 IBC $54.00/hour 
3. Inspections when no fee is specifically indicated (minimum charge -one hour) $54.00/hour    
4. Additional plan review required by changes, additions or revisions to plans…. $54.00/ hour 
5. Issuance of each Temporary Certificate of Occupancy (TCO) and extensions…$600.00 
      There will be a $600 fee for a temporary certificate of occupancy.   A Temporary Certificate of 
      Occupancy shall be valid for 180 days.  If a full Certificate of Occupancy is issued within the 
      first 30 days, all but $40 will be refunded.  If a full Certificate of Occupancy is issued prior to 
      the 180-day expiration, $100 shall be refunded for each 30-day period remaining out of the 
      original 180-day validity period of the Temporary Certificate of Occupancy. 
6. A penalty fee will be assessed up to or equal to the building permit fee for work commenced without 
first obtaining a building permit per IRC Section R108.6/IBC Section 109.4 
7.  A Code Compliance (CC) fee will be assessed on permits associated with a CC case…$100 
8. Use of outside consultants for plan checking, inspections, or both …………  Actual Cost 
9. Docket fee for Board of Appeals……………………………………………   $55.00 
10. Short-term Rental Conversion Permit …………………………………….     $300 - $600
